Our Approach to Downstream Oil and Gas

650+

downstream consulting cases across refining, fuel retail, and commercial transformation since 2024

300+

experts with deep downstream industry, digital, and operational excellence

Leading downstream companies are strengthening strategy, transforming operations, and scaling AI to compete in an increasingly complex market. BCG’s downstream oil and gas consulting teams partner with clients across the value chain, from refining and integrated petrochemical operations to fuel retail and commercial operations, combining deep proprietary data, advanced analytics, and hands-on transformation experience to deliver measurable results.

Refining Strategy and Asset Optimization

Refineries must balance margin performance, capital allocation, and decarbonization priorities. Our refinery consulting teams help clients optimize portfolios, improve refinery performance, and define practical pathways through the energy transition, including renewable fuels integration and Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions reduction.

Fuel Retail and Commercial Transformation

Changing customer expectations and new mobility ecosystems are reshaping fuel retail. BCG’s fuel retail consulting expertise helps operators reposition networks, diversify revenue streams, and strengthen the digital and commercial capabilities needed to compete.

Applied AI and Digital Transformation

Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming a competitive differentiator across downstream operations. From AI-enabled scheduling and value chain optimization and predictive maintenance to dynamic pricing and value chain optimization, BCG helps clients scale digital capabilities and improve operational decision-making.

Energy Transition and Decarbonization

The energy transition is reshaping downstream portfolios and investment decisions. BCG’ downstream oil and gas consulting teams help clients reduce emissions, evaluate renewable fuels, and identify new sources of value through low-carbon investments and resilient operating models.

Organization and Operating Model Transformation

Lasting transformation requires strategy, operations, and people to evolve together. BCG works with downstream oil and gas leaders to redesign operating models, build new capabilities, and strengthen governance so organizations can move faster and execute with precision.

Our Clients’ Success in Downstream Oil and Gas

A US refinery sought to optimize scheduling, maximize margins, and respond more quickly to changing operating conditions. BCG's refinery consulting experts implemented an AI-powered scheduling solution, combining a refinery-wide digital twin with advanced optimization algorithms. The solution generated multimillion-dollar annual value while reducing planning and scheduling activities from hours to less than 10 minutes.

A US refiner wanted to strengthen renewable diesel profitability while reducing carbon intensity. BCG evaluated low-carbon technologies, renewable fuels opportunities, and strategic partnerships to develop an integrated asset roadmap. The strategy identified opportunities to move the facility from third-quartile to first-quartile industry performance.

An Australian fuel retailer sought to strengthen fuel pricing and respond more efficiently to changing market conditions. Using AI and advanced analytics, BCG developed a next-generation pricing engine that optimized pricing decisions across more than 600 service stations. The solution increased gross profit by 7% while driving a 5% increase in fuel volumes.

An African refinery aimed to improve the economics and strategic value of an expansion program. BCG assessed market demand, project economics, and value-creation opportunities to optimize the investment strategy and enhance long-term competitiveness. The assessment revealed opportunities to optimize project CAPEX by more than $300 million, de-risk project delivery, and increase asset EBITDA by $160 million annually, resulting in an internal rate of return of up to 15%.
